EventInfo.Description: Excellent. Let us travel forth and scourge the Earthlings' vessels with our secret fire.
Thank you, my leader. Security and obedience above all.
These strands of fungal filaments, rich in the nucleic acids of this world.
These luminous stones, warm to the touch.
This ritual incense, infused with the intoxicating mire of faraway marshes.
Artifacts of the departed Progenitors, mysterious and unknowable.
Remnants of a human expedition. Now how did these get here?
You honor us too greatly, brother. Friendship is the only gift we ask.
A mighty Smuggler to quickly travel beyond the skies of our planet, and perhaps even reach Earth itself.
A wise Venerable Elder, to lead our people toward freedom and plot the abduction of Earthling servants.
An Industrious Cyborg, strong and adaptable to any industrial task.
A Brilliant Polymath, wise in all conceivable arts and sciences.
An Elite Warrior, fearless and mighty in defense of our race.
A talented Cultivator, enabling the people of %s2_city to quickly advance beyond their primitive beginnings.
Two thousand fortunes in age-old Progenitor wealth.
Curses! Those grasping tyrants cannot be tolerated much longer!
Let them try in vain.. our assets have been carefully hidden across a myriad of offworld accounts.

Excellent. Our Physicists say that with the right technology, they should be able to create functioning Fusion Cores from the materials inside without the need for mining and extraction of raw Uranium.
Excellent.. although only a detailed knowledge of Progenitor Symbology will permit us to decode these fiendlishly complex hieroglyphics..
Superb. With sufficient understanding of Progenitor weaponry, our Artificers can create functioning munitions from the technology inside.
Superb. With sufficient understanding of Progenitor weaponry, our Artificers can create functioning munitions from the technology inside.
Wonderful.. a deep core mining complex such as this will bring us a neverending flow of valuable metals.
An interesting find.. I wonder what a Nanotechnologist would make of those strange pools of metallic slurry?
An interesting find.. I wonder what a Nanotechnologist would make of those strange pools of metallic slurry?
This facility seems near-impregnable. One might theorize that it could prove of great strategic value in a revolution.. not that I would entertain such treasonous thoughts, you understand.
We have no need for this ancient wreckage. Destroy the structure after ransacking it for anything useful that can be saved.
